book.name: 2 Abhatɨsarʉʉnikɨ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ya kabhɨrɨ ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhatɨsarʉʉnikɨ

content: Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu araaza kuricha umwangi
Nangʉ abhahiiri bhɨɨtʉ, tʉrabhasabha igʉrʉ wu ukuuza kʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, na chɨmbu turiibhiringɨ kwewe.
Tʉrabhasabha,
mʉtakangwa na kʉbha nʉ ʉrʉhaho, urusikʉ rwu ukuuza Ʉmʉkʉrʉ ruhikirɨ. Hamwɨ mwigwirɨbhu kʉmangʼana obhorebhe gʉ ʉbhʉrʉʉti, hamwɨ gu ubhurwazi, hamwɨ gɨ ɨnyarʉbha yɨnʉ ikwiseegwa iruurɨ kwa niitwɨ.
Mutiisirirya ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi kʉbhakangirirya kwa ryʉryʉsi, kʉ kʉbha urusikʉ ruyo rʉtakuhika, kuhika zisikʉ zirya abhaatʉ bhakwanga Mungu nu umwangi wurya
arorekanɨ. Wuyo newe akurichwa chwe.

Nawe hinga araanga ebhegero bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ abhaatʉ bhakorora kʉbha ni‑mungu hamwɨ kɨnʉ bhakosengera, na ariitʉʉra igʉrʉ wa bhyʉsi. Arasikɨra na kwikara mwihekaaru rya Mungu, na kwikurya kʉbha ewe newe Mungu.
Mʉtakuhiita hanʉ naarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ nɨkabhabhʉʉrɨra gayo gʉʉsi?
Na nangʉ mwɨzɨ kɨnʉ kekomorecha, korereke ɨrɨkɨnibhwɨ ribhaga rɨnʉ rikwɨndibhwa.
Nʉʉrʉ nangwɨnʉ umwangi wuyo arakora emeremo ɨnʉ iibhisirɨ. Nawe atakororekana kuhika wʉnʉ akomorecha hanʉ ariruushibhweho.
Hayo neho umwangi wuyo arɨɨrɨkɨnibhwɨ, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu aramwita nu umwika kurwa mumunywa gwazɨ, na aramuricha nu ubhwɨrʉ bhu ukuuza kwazɨ.
Ribhaga ryu ukuuza kwazɨ, umwangi wuyo araaza na amanaga gʉʉsi ga Shɨtaani
no okokora ibhyɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ na amateemo gʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ.
Arabhakangirirya kwa nzɨra yʉyʉʉsi, bhanʉ bhʉʉsi bharɨ mʉnzɨra yʉ ʉkʉbhʉra, kʉ kʉbha bhatiisiriiryɨ kʉsɨɨga amaheene korereke bhatʉrɨ kʉsabhurwa.
Necho Mungu abhiisiririiryɨ bhakangatibhwɨ na amanaga ga amakangirirya, korereke bhangʼehe kwisirirya ʉrʉrɨmɨ.
Mmbe bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhatakwisirirya amaheene na kozomererwa ʉbhʉbhɨ, bharatinirwa.
Kwimɨɨrɨra bhwɨma

Nawe itwɨ, toreenderwa kukumya Mungu ribhaga ryʉsi, igʉrʉ waanyu, imwɨ abhahiiri bhanʉ mʉsɨɨgirwɨ nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu. Toreenderwa kokorabhu, kʉ kʉbha Mungu akabharobhora imwɨ kwɨma isimʉka yu ubhubhumbi korereke mobhone ubhutuurya. Ubhutuurya bhuyo mʉbhʉsʉngʼaanirɨ kwa kʉbhɨngukibhwa ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu na kʉnzɨra yu ukwisirirya amaheene.
Mungu akabhabhɨrɨkɨra, korereke mobhone ubhutuurya bhuyo kʉnzɨra yɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yɨnʉ twarwazirɨ kwa niimwɨ. Abhabhirikiirɨ korereke mobhone kugwatana mubhwɨrʉ bhwʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Nangʉ abhahiiri bhɨɨtʉ, mwimɨɨrɨrɨ bhwɨma na kugwata amiija ganʉ mwasʉngʼaanirɨ, ɨbhɨ nɨ‑kwa amaragɨrɨra gɨɨtʉ hamwɨ kʉzɨnyarʉbha kurwa kwa niitwɨ.
Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ umwene na Bhaabha wɨɨtʉ Mungu wʉnʉ atʉsɨɨgirɨ, na kʉbhɨgʉngi bhyazɨ aratohonʼya kemerano na kotoha ubhwisɨgi ʉbhʉzʉmu.
Tʉrabhasabha bhabhahɨ umwʉyʉ na kʉbhakongʼya, korereke mʉtʉrɨ kʉgamba na kokora amazʉmu.

footnotes.text: Umwangi wurya, enzobhooro yaku nu‑mwangi wa Kiriisitʉ wʉnʉ ahaanga Mungu na kʉkɨra imigirʉ jazɨ jʉsi. Umwangi wʉnʉ atangɨ Shɨtaani, nawe arahʉkɨribhwa na Shɨtaani kubhwɨndi bhwazɨ bhu ukwanga Mungu.
